summary_md: **Xiaohang Yu ([@xhyumiracle](https://x.com/xhyumiracle/status/2115735551026639078))** open-sources **family.skill**, a brainstorming and research skill based on Stanford's STORM: one prompt assembles a team of field experts who research independently, a fact-checker verifies sources, and the final report lays out consensus and disagreements ([xhyumiracle/family-skill](https://github.com/xhyumiracle/family-skill)).
